about_the_game:
This is a small game that tests players' quick reaction ability!

The game graphics are fresh and bright. Players need to use the space bar to control the ball's jump and avoid various obstacles.

If you are unfortunate enough to touch an obstacle, the game will end.

The ball moves very fast, so players' reaction speed must keep up with its pace.

The game is cleverly designed. Every jump and collision with an obstacle greatly enhances the tension and immersive feeling of the game.

This is a game that not only tests reaction ability but also is full of fun, and it is suitable for players of all age groups to try.

Gameplay

Players will manipulate a ball.

The ball will automatically move forward quickly.

Players can only control the ball's jump.

Players need to control the ball to jump over obstacles.

If the ball fails to jump over the obstacle, the game will end in failure.

Game operation method

Jump = SPACE
